    finalize_route()

    # Local repair: try to improve by swapping endpoints to reduce number of routes
    # Deterministic, simple: if a route has a small last customer that could fit into previous route, move it.
    i = 0
    while i < len(routes) - 1:

        r2 = routes[i+1]

            continue
